correctness.rationale: PASS: For all finite fields of characteristic >3 and every nonempty retained cubic graph mask B with fixed q^-1 frequency normalization, character orthogonality reduces the fourth-power norm quotient to Q/S^2. Nonzero pair sum s and cubic sum fix ab and the unordered pair; the zero fiber is precisely the antipodal pairs and optional origin diagonal. Directly subtracting and replacing that fiber gives Q=2S^2-P4-2R+|f(0)|^4+|sum_t f(t)f(-t)|^2. When k=0 or b=0,k=1, ordinary Cauchy-Schwarz gives 2-1/m, all site moduli equal and phases arbitrary. In the active case monotonicity in balanced pair-product moduli, phase alignment, and weighted Cauchy-Schwarz with L=b/2+2k/3>1 give 3-1/L=3-6/(3b+4k); equality forces zero orphan mass, weights 3/(3b+4k) at center and 2/(3b+4k) per paired site, and aligned antipodal products. Direct two-sum convolution independently checked all 158 nonempty masks for F5 and F7 against the claimed sharp-attaining amplitudes. These finite checks do not prove all fields.
